convert_fullcell_to_she: convert a full cell voltage value to half cell voltage vs SHE using get_she
convert_fullcell_to_halfcell: convert a full cell voltage to both SHE and RHE scales using fullcell2halfcell
load_calibration_data: load the calibration data dictionary for voltage conversion using load_calibration_data_for_voltage_conversion
convert_she_to_rhe: convert a SHE potential to RHE scale using she2rhe with pH and reference potential
correct_potential_with_ir_drop: correct a measured potential for IR drop and convert to RHE using correct_potential
